# sreagent_teams (Data Source)

Every team row, read-only. A team. Its members are sreagent_team_member resources or are managed in the app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sreagent_teams" "all" {}

output "teams_count" {
  value = length(data.sreagent_teams.all.items)
}
```
